title: lomatium triternatum var. alatum
intro: Lomatium triternatum var. alatum, commonly known as Desert Biscuit Root, is a perennial plant that belongs to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory infections, such as the common cold and flu, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Desert Biscuit Root include its antiviral, antifungal, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
